name: ARPL index
description: Machine-readable index of ARPL instruction packs. Generated by tools/build_catalogs.py; read AGENTS.md for how to use it.

work_classes.W1: Component family authoring (driven by a source and an LOD)
work_classes.W2: Adaptive / form-driven geometry (driven by a rig)
work_classes.W3: Layout-driven assembly production (driven by a rule applied many times)
work_classes.W4: Building model authoring (driven by a program and system families)
work_classes.W5: Model change and propagation (driven by one changed fundamental)
work_classes.W6: Documentation production (driven by views and sheets)
work_classes.W7: Information and data (driven by parameters, standards, quantities)
work_classes.W8: Analysis and review (driven by questions about an existing model)

project_workflows.title: ADU exterior wall fabrication package (LOD 400 + BOM)
project_workflows.intent: Turn the exterior walls of a one-storey wood-frame ADU into prefabricated wall panels: 2x6 framing, 3/4in plywood, bevel siding, XPS cavity fill; one assembly per wall; shop drawings; BOM and cost.

steps.do: Build and flex-test component families (lumber, sheet panel, insulation block, siding board)
Write the layout rule (studs 16in o.c., 3-stud corners, double top plate lapped, openings with king/jack/header/sill/cripples, sheets on stud centres, siding courses, foam per cavity)
2D preview from the rule: studs in plan, sheet and board joints in elevations; user confirms or corrects the rule
Resolve design conflicts found by the preview as user decisions (door lowered to fit a header) and re-preview
Replay the rule in 3D per wall; disallow joins on all framing; verify every piece; group into assemblies
Assembly shop drawings: framing and sheathing elevations, plan section, 3D, part list; trade dimension style; PDF review
Quantities and cost from the model; governed BOM parameters

packs.title: Assembly naming and identical panels
use_when: creating and naming Revit assemblies
several identical panels or modules need drawings
packs.rule: Name assemblies after commit; document identical assemblies once with a quantity ('build 2').
validation: Assembly type names and member counts read back

packs.title: Vertical studs pulled by auto-joins
use_when: placing vertical studs, posts or braces as structural framing
framing members end up longer or shifted after placement
packs.rule: Disallow joins on all framing members immediately at creation and verify positions after regeneration.
validation: Interference check between all assemblies
Stud end heights read back

packs.title: Door too tall for a header
use_when: framing a wall with openings where headers must fit under top plates
a door or window rough opening is close to the plate height
packs.rule: Report every opening whose rough opening plus header doesn't fit under the plates as a decision for the user; never move a header into the top plates.
validation: Rough opening and header heights dimensioned on the shop drawing

packs.title: Plywood slivers at openings
use_when: laying out sheathing, sheet goods or cladding boards across a wall with openings
deciding where panel joints fall relative to windows and doors
packs.rule: Minimum remnant width is a parameter of the layout rule and is evaluated on both sides of every opening edge.
validation: Measured joint positions in the preview
Piece-by-piece check of the 3D build

packs.title: Revit Parts for wall layers: a dead end
use_when: splitting wall layers into separate fabrication pieces
considering Revit Parts (PartUtils.CreateParts) for panels or BOM
not_for: Parts for simple area takeoffs or visual layer display
packs.rule: For fabrication panels use component families plus assemblies, not Parts. Check how established tools solve a task before choosing a method.
validation: Method review against two commercial tools

packs.title: Power connector without load parameters
use_when: adding electrical power connectors to equipment families
connecting a family to an electrical circuit
packs.rule: Use PowerBalanced for equipment power connectors and probe associability before associating.
validation: Connector parameters read back
Flex test of the associated parameters

packs.title: Shop drawings: invalid references and swapped elevations
use_when: creating dimensioned shop drawings or assembly sheets
adding many dimensions by script
packs.rule: Isolate risky annotation in its own transaction and verify every sheet visually.
validation: PDF export rendered and reviewed per sheet

packs.title: Project units round framing dimensions
use_when: dimensioning fabrication or shop drawings for a trade
dimensions round to project units and hide small values
packs.rule: Shop drawings get their own dimension style matching the trade's units.
validation: PDF review

packs.title: Annotation family from a newer Revit version
use_when: loading or editing annotation families (tags, labels)
loading a family saved in another Revit version
packs.rule: Check BasicFileInfo before loading; keep the file name equal to the family name; capture element ids (not objects) before a reload. Labels in annotation families can't be created or retyped by the API, only moved.
validation: Family name and id read back after reload

packs.title: Coffee brewer from a spec sheet: overall height short
use_when: building an equipment family from a manufacturer spec sheet or drawing
overall dimensions don't match after modelling
packs.rule: Before modelling, reconcile every overall dimension on the source against the sum of the parts in each view.
validation: Bounding box height against the sheet's overall height

packs.title: Template with hidden geometry
use_when: choosing a family template for a new family
family geometry is invisible or too large after building
packs.rule: Build from the Generic Model template and set the category; check the bounding box after building.
validation: Bounding box against the modelled size

packs.title: Faucet on the wrong side: mirrored source view
use_when: modelling from orthographic views of a source drawing
deciding left/right or front/back orientation of a product
packs.rule: Establish orientation from features visible in at least two views, never from one view's layout.
validation: Visual comparison of the family 3D view with two source views

packs.title: Component families for a wall panel
use_when: building parametric component families for lumber, sheets, insulation or cladding
families that must flex reliably before mass placement
packs.rule: Generate component families from templates by script, with locks on all faces, then flex-test before placing any instance.
validation: Flex test of each type with measured bounding boxes

packs.title: Forms absorb model lines and break hosting
use_when: building adaptive components or forms from profiles
hosted elements lose their host after form edits
packs.rule: Use reference lines for every profile in adaptive rigs, and verify hosting by behaviour (move test), not by element ids.
validation: Move test of each driver point

packs.title: Gable walls without wall attachment
use_when: walls under gable or sloped roofs
walls that should follow a roof slope
packs.rule: Use profile walls for gables and register them as dependents of the roof and the levels.
validation: Section view check

packs.title: Footing corner notches
use_when: modelling foundations or footings at wall corners
relying on automatic joins at corners
packs.rule: Model corner conditions explicitly; never rely on automatic joins.
validation: Plan and 3D check of footing corners

packs.title: Lowering a level: what doesn't follow
use_when: changing a level elevation or another fundamental datum
a change must propagate to walls, roofs, openings and layouts
packs.rule: Before changing a fundamental, list every dependent by type of constraint and plan the fix for each.
validation: Sections and elevations exported and reviewed
Window heads against the new wall top

packs.title: Markup read without checking the camera
use_when: interpreting markups or redlines on a 3D view or screenshot
reviewing feedback given on a 3D image
packs.rule: Read the camera before interpreting any 3D markup.
validation: Orientation read back

packs.title: Door swing reported correct without a test
use_when: placing, swapping or flipping doors
reporting door swing or hand
packs.rule: Verify door swing geometrically and re-check after every door swap or move.
validation: Room.IsPointInRoom on the swing-arc midpoint

packs.title: Windows placed at sill 0
use_when: placing windows, doors or other hosted families by script
packs.rule: Set every placement-relevant instance parameter explicitly.
validation: Sill heights read back

packs.title: Cost per type can't carry a BOM
use_when: preparing a bill of materials (BOM) or cut list from families
adding cost or quantity fields to schedules
packs.rule: Define BOM fields as shared parameters in the information contract (A5) before authoring families.
validation: Schedule read back

packs.title: Cost estimate priced the wrong construction
use_when: estimating material or construction costs from a model
pricing wall, floor or roof types
packs.rule: Ask the construction method before any cost or structural work.
validation: Quantities from HOST_VOLUME_COMPUTED and HOST_AREA_COMPUTED

packs.title: Layout preview as a review step
use_when: any layout-driven build: studs, panels, cladding, tiles, ceiling grids
before committing many repeated elements in 3D
packs.rule: Every layout-driven build (W3) gets a 2D preview from the same rule and a user confirmation.
validation: User confirmation

packs.title: Crops silently ignored
use_when: setting crop boxes or scope boxes on views
exported views show more than intended
packs.rule: Read back every crop after setting it.
validation: Crop read-back
Image or PDF review

packs.title: Section looking the wrong way
use_when: creating sections or elevations by script
a new section or elevation looks the wrong way
packs.rule: After creating any view, compare its ViewDirection with the intended direction.
validation: ViewDirection read back

failure_patterns.name: Geometry correct, semantics wrong
failure_patterns.meaning: The shape is right but the category, role or family kind is wrong for downstream use.

failure_patterns.name: Wrong coordinate frame or orientation
failure_patterns.meaning: Mirrored views, wrong view direction, assumed camera, transforms defaulting to world axes.

failure_patterns.name: Existing content should have been reused
failure_patterns.meaning: A governed family, parameter or standard existed and was recreated.

failure_patterns.name: Missing fabrication or material constraint
failure_patterns.meaning: The layout is geometrically valid but cannot be built from stock material.

failure_patterns.name: API succeeded, model result wrong
failure_patterns.meaning: The call returned without error but Revit changed something else (auto-joins, ignored defaults, silent overrides).

failure_patterns.name: Correct model, unusable schedule or data
failure_patterns.meaning: Values exist but can't be scheduled, totalled or extracted.

failure_patterns.name: Correct element, wrong authority
failure_patterns.meaning: A value or decision was taken by the agent that belongs to the user, a standard or a discipline.

failure_patterns.name: Correct geometry, documentation fails
failure_patterns.meaning: Views, crops, dimensions or sheets don't show the model correctly.

failure_patterns.name: Source misread
failure_patterns.meaning: A dimension, view or note in the source document was missed or misinterpreted.

failure_patterns.name: Dependency not propagated
failure_patterns.meaning: A change in one element left dependents (profile walls, levels, hosted inserts, sheets) unchanged.

failure_patterns.name: Runtime blocked by a dialog
failure_patterns.meaning: A modal Revit dialog or warning blocked the automation; nothing visible in the API result.

failure_patterns.name: Fix incomplete
failure_patterns.meaning: The correction addressed one case of the problem; the same problem reappeared in a neighbouring case.
